purpose: Adapter expansion for 07C global microscope-slide survey entries, with harvest-family assignments for later batch implementation.
guards: Fetch public metadata only; do not bulk-download images.
Preserve source relationship language and collection-level uncertainty.
Do not infer item identity from taxon/name overlap alone.
Keep non-glass or mixed-material slide types explicitly marked rather than silently normalized.

adapters.institution_scope: University of St Andrews Libraries and Museums
adapters.target: single collection record with stable collection ID
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve collection ID, named users/contributors and commercial mounters; do not invent item count.
Preserve donor, stated count and expedition provenance.

adapters.target: collection overview with associated microscope slides
adapters.promotion_rule: Use only as collection-presence evidence until a dedicated slide catalogue or count is found.

adapters.institution_scope: Ohio State University Museum of Biological Diversity Herbarium
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract count, cabinet structure and collector list as separate evidence fields.
Preserve named subcollections and donation/research provenance.
Preserve published-exsiccata versus unique-collection distinction and set-specific serial numbers.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Colorado Museum of Natural History
adapters.promotion_rule: Keep historical exsiccata and modern Kociolek collection as separate acquisition strata.

adapters.institution_scope: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
adapters.target: Algae Herbarium page plus Botany Collections Search
adapters.promotion_rule: Separate collection-page claims from item/search records; preserve preparation type and accession data.
Extract count, index structure and label conventions; current institutional register remains separate.

adapters.institution_scope: University of British Columbia Spencer Entomological Collection
adapters.target: Spencer Slide Collection and linked gallery/search
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve G.J.S. Spencer personal-collection identity and link gallery records without flattening them into one item count unless pagination confirms it.
Preserve approximate count and reference-collection scope; do not equate mounted examples with unique slide count unless source wording permits.

adapters.target: archive feature describing boxed microscope-slide batch
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat as a coherent archival batch and future finding-aid target; preserve original-box context.
Promote historical collection presence and contributor names; exact count requires museum register.
Use as collection-scale existence and provenance-workflow evidence; later connect to Geoscience Australia catalogue/API.

adapters.institution_scope: National Library of New Zealand / Alexander Turnbull Library
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve former ownership, box count and existence of the 1948 slide list; do not infer individual slide count.
Extract acquisition date, radiolarian/diatom subcounts, named preparers/leaders and research-program context.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum of Denmark / University of Copenhagen
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve historical collector/publication strata and follow searchable digitised slide records.
Use dataset exports to filter preparation/preservation fields; report slide subset only if fields support it.

adapters.target: museum-journal article with slide inventory tables
adapters.promotion_rule: Parse species/type tables and label-field description; do not promote article row numbers as museum accession numbers.
Harvest taxon and locality list pages as index-level records; keep item count unresolved until lists are enumerated.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Nature and Science Tokyo
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve reference-center and distribution function; exact holdings/count require MRC or Science Museum Net data.
Extract stated slide count, database context and taxonomic collection scope; later identify public Specify endpoint if available.
